old: Some even dismiss + 对象
new: 主语（如 Some / Some people）+ (even) + dismiss + 对象
理由: 例句[1]主语是 Many students 且没有 even，公式把 Some even 写死了

old: that + made + 人 + 形容词 …
new: that + 动词（如 made + 人 + 形容词 / taught + 人 + 名词）…
理由: 例句[0]用的是 taught me the value of kindness，照公式写不出来

old: (as a whole). For one thing, … For another, …
new: (as a whole)（后文可用 For one thing, … For another, … 展开）
理由: 两个例句都只有一句，没有 For one thing / For another，应标明是后文展开方式而非句式本身

old: is a better … for everyone.
new: is a better + 名词 (+ for everyone / for all / to do …).
理由: 例句[0]是 a better place to learn，例句[1]是 for all，公式把 for everyone 写死了

old: A + matters on two levels. For individuals, … For society, …
new: A + matter(s) on two levels（后面分两层展开，如 For individuals, … For society, … / : … and … / both for … and for …）
理由: 例句用冒号或 both for … and for … 展开，且例句[1]主语复数用 matter，公式写死了 matters 和 For individuals / For society

old: 领域 such as A, B and C + are opening
new: 主语（如 领域 such as A, B (and C)）+ are opening
理由: 例句[0]是 many industries，没有 such as；例句[1]只列两项

old: 主语 + 谓语 + to do …, doing A
new: 主语 + 谓语 (+ to do) …, doing A
理由: 例句[0] are joining community groups 后面没有 to do，不定式应为可选

old: 主语 + find + a sense of + 名词 + that + money alone cannot bring
new: 主语 + find / gain / give + 名词（如 a sense of …）+ that + money alone cannot + 动词 / no + 名词 + can + 动词
理由: 例句用 gain a kind of joy … cannot buy、gives … a richness of mind that no screen can offer，公式写得太死

old: how … , what … and even which …
new: wh 从句（how / what / which / whom …，可以两三项并列，最后一项前可加 even）
理由: 例句[0]用了 whom，例句[1]只有 what 和 how 两项且顺序不同

old: + that + 主语 + 谓语 …
new: + that（强调人时也可用 who）+ 句子其余部分 …
理由: 例句[1] It was my grandfather who first taught me… 强调的是主语，who 后面没有主语，照公式写不出

old: Whether it is A, B or C, 主语
new: Whether it is A, B or C（可以两三项）, 主语
理由: 例句[0]只有 a math problem or a personal conflict 两项

old: Good + 名词 + involves more than
new: 主语（名词短语，如 Good + 名词 / 动名词短语）+ involves more than
理由: 两个例句主语是 Being a good friend、Protecting the environment，不是 Good + 名词

old: Third, and perhaps most importantly
new: Third / Finally, and perhaps most importantly
理由: 例句[1]用的是 Finally

old: 主语 + 行动1, 行动2 and finally + 结果
new: 主语 + 行动1 (, 行动2) and finally + 结果
理由: 两个例句都只有一个行动再接 and finally

old: In short, 主语 + are inevitable, but they need not be + 形容词
new: (In short,) 主语 + is / are inevitable, but it / they need not be + 形容词 / 名词
理由: 例句没有 In short；例句[0]接名词 a source of shame，例句[1]是单数 Change is … it

old: have made it easier
new: have / has made it easier
理由: 例句[0]单数主语 Online shopping 用 has made

old: Using + 宾语 + 副词 + means
new: 动名词短语（如 Using + 宾语 + 副词）+ means
理由: 例句主语是 Studying effectively、Being a good leader，没有 Using

old: A + 过去分词 + 副词 + can
new: (A) + 名词 + 过去分词 (+ 副词 / 介词短语) + can
理由: 例句[1] Food wasted in restaurants 没有 A，过去分词后接的是介词短语

old: 主体, for their part, should + 动词1 … and + 动词2 …
new: 主体, for their / its part, should + 动词1 … (and + 动词2 …)
理由: 例句只有一个动词；例句[1]单数主语用 for its part

old: To meet these expectations / requirements,
new: To meet + 名词（如 these expectations / requirements / the needs of …）,
理由: 例句[1]是 To meet the needs of an aging society

old: 主语 + should + 动词 … step by step,
new: 主语 + should / can + 动词 … (step by step),
理由: 例句[1] Students can reduce stress 没有 should，也没有 step by step

old: , which can be + 过去分词 + through …
new: (, which + 补充说明，如 can be + 过去分词 + through …)
理由: 例句[0] which can protect us… 不是被动结构，which 从句应为可选、内容不固定

old: will + 动词 … when …
new: will + 动词 … (when …)
理由: 例句[0] will write with confidence 没有 when 从句

old: This concern / view is not groundless.
new: This / Their + concern / worry / view … + is not groundless (, for / since + 理由).
理由: 例句用 This worry、Their complaint，并在后面接 for / since 理由，公式写得太死

old: it is exactly through / by
new: it is (exactly) through / by
理由: 例句[1] It is through daily practice … 没有 exactly

old: can + 动词1 … and + 动词2 …
new: can + 动词1 … (and + 动词2 …)
理由: 例句[0] can be a powerful tool for learning 只有一个动词

old: The key, therefore, lies in
new: The key (to …) (, therefore,) lies in
理由: 例句[1] The key to success lies in … 没有 therefore，多了 to success

old: We should treat it as A rather than B, using it to do … while + 动名词 …
new: 主语 + should treat + 对象 + as A rather than B (, using it / them to do … while + 动名词 …)
理由: 例句[0]只有 treat mistakes as … rather than …，例句[1]主语是 Students、宾语 online translators

old: is one that
new: is one that / who
理由: 例句[0] A good teacher is one who …

old: if it is too + 形容词2
new: if it / they + is / are too + 形容词2
理由: 例句[1]是 if they are too easygoing

old: However, + 名词 + alone is not enough.
new: (However,) 名词 + alone is / are not enough (to do …).
理由: 例句[1]没有 However、复数用 are；例句[0]后接 to make …

old: will greatly + 动词原形
new: will (greatly) + 动词原形
理由: 例句[1] will help you stay healthy 没有 greatly
